mapper.sql: review_run_id, round, tioka_run_id, model_version, checkpoint_set_version, status, stats_json
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lease_review_round (review_run_id, round, tioka_run_id, model_version, checkpoint_set_version, status, stats_json) VALUES ( #{row.reviewRunId}, #{row.round}, #{row.tiokaRunId}, #{row.modelVersion}, #{row.checkpointSetVersion}, #{row.status}, #{row.statsJson}::jsonb ) ON CONFLICT (review_run_id, round) DO UPDATE SET tioka_run_id = EXCLUDED.tioka_run_id, model_version = EXCLUDED.model_version, checkpoint_set_version = EXCLUDED.checkpoint_set_version, status = EXCLUDED.status, stats_json = EXCLUDED.stats_json
